data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 the Syndicate released GBP 35.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2017: GBP 39.4m, arising predominantly from the Treaty, Energy and Marine Divisions (2017: primarily from the Energy and Marine Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2018.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,962.8m. During 2018 the Syndicate reported a release of technical reserves in respect of prior periods of GBP 35.2m, driven by favourable claims development, predominantly in Treaty, Energy and Marine divisions. The year was affected by a number of large catastrophe events in both 2017 and 2018 which influenced ultimate estimates, but overall prior-year experience produced a modest release relative to opening reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year reserve movement: the primary movement note states a release of GBP 35.2m of "technical reserves" for prior periods (page 19). The note wording references technical reserves (which can include UPR as well as claims), and does not explicitly state whether this GBP 35.2m is a GROSS claims-outstanding movement or a NET figure after reinsurance. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report but is affected by a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction of the UK Division shown in the Technical Reserves table (RITC of the UK Division (199.7) under claims outstanding) which distorts direct extraction of a reliable gross prior-year movement from the triangle. Given these ambiguities, the report-level narrative figure of a GBP 35.2m release has been used as the prior-year development (assumed to indicate an overall release); this has been flagged with moderate confidence. Lob-level movements are described qualitatively (predominantly Treaty, Energy and Marine) but not quantified in gross terms. The claims development triangle is present but was not used to compute prior-year movement due to RITC distortion and readibility limits in the scan.

_claims_triangle.note: A gross claims development triangle appears in the notes but extraction was not used because of RITC distortions shown in the Technical Reserves (RITC of the UK Division) and limitations in reliably reading all development diagonals from the scanned image.
